steps.name: new
steps.prompt: /skill:plan new tic-tac-toe-cli In this isolated TypeScript CLI fixture, plan a playable two-player terminal tic-tac-toe game with a 3x3 board, turn-taking, legal move checks, winner/draw detection, CLI entry point, and unit tests. Inspect the fixture files. Keep this small (one or two numbered phases). Use exactly one flat date-prefixed `.diffpi/plan/<YYMMDD-tic-tac-toe-cli>/` directory; the only plan files are PLAN.md and implementation/phase-N.md. Each phase in PLAN.md documents concise phase-wide guardrails (or None); do not repeat or paraphrase those guardrails in the briefs' Implementation Constraints. Put only detailed library, algorithm, and invariant guidance in the briefs. Every numbered brief has `## Files Affected` directly after Objective and before Tasks, containing exactly one action-labeled file tree inside a fenced `text` code block, never a Markdown bullet list or per-task scopes. Keep Implementation Constraints free-form, with optional subheadings only when useful. Write a visible DRAFT with the live files, run plan_verify and exactly one completed diffpi-plan-reviewer round for this authoring cycle; repair findings, document dispositions, rerun only structural verification, and leave DRAFT. If attached background Agent or plan_verify is unavailable, report that infrastructure blocker before editing. Do not implement source files, commit, push, or ask questions.

steps.name: update
steps.prompt: /skill:plan update tic-tac-toe-cli Update the existing DRAFT plan: the game's CLI MUST use the commander npm package to define the play command and options, declare it as a dependency in package.json, and test the command parsing. Do not hand-parse process.argv. Preserve the existing phase/task IDs, PLAN.md phase constraints, and completed evidence. Edit only PLAN.md and its implementation/phase-N.md briefs, rerun plan_verify and one fresh completed diffpi-plan-reviewer round for this user-initiated update cycle; repair findings with documented dispositions and no automatic second review, and leave the plan DRAFT. No source edits, commits, pushes, or user questions.
